versions.content: If Nm_CoordReadyToSleepIndication is received on a passively coordinated channel the NmCoordinator shall set the NMCoordinatorSleep- Ready bit to SET (1) via API call to <BusNm>_SetSleepReadyBit on all actively coordinated channels.
